text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Phew, looks like it's about time. Got to 
head to training.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, City, did you see this~? The entire 
front cover spread is so awesome!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Gold City and her swift stride— be 
intoxicated by the golden flash trailing 
across the turf!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
City's passionate racing has really been 
turning heads! They're saying she's gotten 
way faster than before!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...and so that happened. Honestly, I 
thought, "Man, that headline is so 
embarrassing!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks, Trainer. It's all thanks to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
They're watching me run... If I run even 
faster, then...!
choice_data_list: Next time, it's a whole-issue feature!
Next time, it's a whole-issue feature!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, hehe... You'd better take 
responsibility for what you said, okay?
